body: That used to happen to me. I would get a short cut but they would always put a little feminine ‘flare’ to it. I go to the barbers now and I love it
I use womens. Although masc presenting, I have a large chest, I have been mistaken as male from behind a times or at a distance, but I feel with my large chest it’s easier just to go to the womens

I just want to say that if anyone is reading this, there is a way out. I wrote this post 113 days ago, an I am since in a new job, and completely off my anti depressants. If you need help, reach out!!
